inventory.description: VIS IsoStation vibration isolation workstation, 36 in x 72 in, 4 in thick PG breadboard, I-325 isolators

top_t.note: 36 in = 914.4 mm, 72 in = 1828.8 mm, 4.3 in = 109.2 mm. Inventory says '4 in thick'; actual PG4 is 4.3 in.; 4.3 in per datasheet; inventory says 4 in

surface_h.note: Product page: 'Working surface height 35.8 in.'; metric twin M-VIS3672-PG4-325A is 909 mm per search snippet.

leg_w.note: frame tube size not published; 3 in assumed

leg_inset_x.note: DIM B; i.e. 1.4 in beyond breadboard each side.; derived: frame overhangs top by (1899.9-1828.8)/2; leg centre = leg_w/2 - overhang

leg_inset_y.note: Brochure dimension drawing, DIM A (top view overall incl. corner brackets/frame).; derived: frame overhangs top by (985.5-914.4)/2

hole_pitch.note: PG breadboard hole grid not in research; Newport standard 1/4-20 on 1 in

hole_offset_x.note: Newport standard 0.5 in border (from OTS drawing)

hole_offset_y.note: Newport standard 0.5 in border (from OTS drawing)

notes: discontinued (replacement VIS3672-PG2-I); frame wider than top
